title: sprint-report template variables
description: Values for templates/sprint-report.md.j2 and templates/sprint-report.html.j2. Generated by tpl-jinja from sprint-report.md; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

bugs_fixed.title: Bugs fixed
bugs_fixed.description: The bugs fixed used under 'Delivery Summary'.

bugs_found.title: Bugs found
bugs_found.description: The bugs found used under 'Quality Metrics'.

scope_added.title: Scope added
scope_added.description: The scope added used under 'Delivery Summary'.

team_size.title: Team size
team_size.description: The team size used under 'Sprint Overview'.
